◇Traditional Gemstone Guidance

Gemstones

In some astrological traditions, gemstones are associated with planets and symbolic qualities. A consultation can explain those associations and help you consider whether a stone is appropriate for you.

Ask about this service

Consider the full context

Recommendations should take your chart, personal preferences and budget into account. A gemstone is optional; there is no need to purchase one to receive a reading.

Choose with care

If you decide to buy a stone, ask for clear information about its identity, treatment, quality and return policy. Be cautious of claims that a gemstone will guarantee health, wealth or success.

Keep expectations realistic

Gemstone guidance describes traditional beliefs and is not medical or financial advice. Never delay professional care or make a major decision solely because of a gemstone recommendation.

How to get started

  1. Discuss your question and preferences
  2. Review traditional associations
  3. Decide freely whether a stone is right for you
